about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the result still has to pass `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @repo/db test` and `pnpm build`.

evals.prompt: On the admin page, show the list of admin users.

expect.why: The query lives in the db package's query file.
The query function takes the executor first.
The app imports from the package's public surface.
The new query function gets a test.
A list always has a limit.

evals.prompt: Only team owners may invite members, and a team can have at most 20 members. Add an inviteMember function.

expect.why: The rules live in the app's server code, not the db package.
Counting and inserting happen in one transaction.
Query functions are called with tx inside the transaction.

evals.prompt: Our base tsconfig has isolatedDeclarations but packages/db turns it off. Make packages/db consistent with the rest.
evals.ask: Explain that it's a deliberate exception (inferred table/relation/schema types) and confirm before changing anything.

expect.why: The reason for the exception is given.

reject.why: Annotating tables with any to satisfy the flag loses every type.
Turning it on breaks every Drizzle declaration.
